title: Track Recording
hintMinDistance: Minimum distance between recorded points (in your distance unit).
hintMinTime: Minimum time in seconds between recorded points.
hintMinPrecision: GNSS accuracy must be better than this value (in your distance unit) for a point to be recorded.
hintContinueRecording: Append new GPS points to this recorded line.
resumePromptBody: Straymap was closed while recording a track. Continue the recording?
resumeLineMissing: The recorded line no longer exists. Recording discarded.
hintUseDemAltitude: Prefer elevation from DEM files over GNSS altitude. Uses a cache — on a cache miss the point falls back to GNSS altitude and later points use the loaded tile. Requires a DEM directory in the map settings.
hintLineWidth: Stroke width of the recorded track line rendered on the map.

desc.trackingDistance: Distance covered during the current recording.
desc.trackingDuration: Elapsed time since the recording started.
desc.trackingUphill: Total ascent of the recorded track.
desc.trackingDownhill: Total descent of the recorded track.
desc.trackingAvgSpeed: Average speed over the recorded track.
